purpose: Select one finite pre-2025 30-calendar-day specification with cross-year migration robustness as the first priority, while secondarily improving mean/worst annual account returns and annual excess returns over the Shanghai Composite.

execution.screening_execution: verified pre-2025 QFQ approximation identical to Batch004/006
execution.final_audit_execution: raw unadjusted OHLC plus complete pre-2025 corporate actions and delistings, identical to Batch007

candidate_origin: Nine fixed structural bridge/ablation specifications formed only from the already frozen OLD and NEW pre-2025 specifications. No Batch008 result is used to add, delete, or alter a candidate.

random_start_screen.sampling: For each year ascending, sample without replacement from sorted execution sessions in January through March, then sort selected starts. All candidates share the same starts; no redraw.
random_start_screen.last_signal_date: calendar year end minus 37 calendar days

selection_rule.rank_normalization: Across the nine fixed candidates, higher-is-better percentile rank using average ties.
selection_rule.annual_core: minimum percentile rank among the four annual components
selection_rule.leave_one_year_out: For each omitted year, recompute the four components on the remaining four years and take their minimum percentile rank; loo_floor is the minimum across five omitted-year folds.
selection_rule.random_start_component: For each candidate and year, mean the five fixed-start returns; start_floor_rank is the percentile rank of the minimum of those five annual means.
selection_rule.parameter_neighborhood: Distance is the count of differing parameter blocks among M_internal, T_internal, H_internal, outer. A candidate's neighborhood is itself plus every fixed candidate at distance one. neighbor_floor is the minimum annual_core among that neighborhood; isolated candidates fall back to self only.
selection_rule.migration_floor: minimum of annual_core, loo_floor, start_floor_rank, and neighbor_floor
strict_order: mean of annual_core, loo_floor, start_floor_rank, neighbor_floor descending
selection_rule.cagr_role: reported only and never used for selection

audit.raw_random_start_audit: Repeat all 25 preregistered champion start runs with raw prices and corporate actions.
